## Qwen 3.8 27B E2EE API

Qwen 3.8 27B E2EE is a large language model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-qwen3-8-27b`. It is end-to-end encrypted. It is also available without end-to-end encryption, as [Qwen 3.8 27B](/models/qwen-3-8-27b).

Qwen 3.8 27B running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A multimodal model with 262K context supporting text and image input. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

### Qwen 3.8 27B E2EE API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `e2ee-qwen3-8-27b` | E2EE | E2EE | $0.47 / $3.53 per 1M |

### Qwen 3.8 27B E2EE specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Alibaba Qwen |
| Released | Sep 6, 2026 |
| Privacy | E2EE |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 256K tokens |
| Max output | 8K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the Qwen 3.8 27B E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-qwen3-8-27b"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-qwen3-8-27b",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
